name: runtime-artifact-registry
title: Add a runtime artifact registry to keep Koala logs out of material freshness
description: Koala runtime artifacts such as .koala/activity.jsonl can be tracked in older projects, then every Koala command dirties the working tree and can stale verification evidence through materialHash. Add a hard-coded runtime artifact registry and wire freshness, init ignore rules, doctor repair, and tests to one source of truth.
